csv_project_name: Developer For B-East Parcel Residential Development
csv_scope_of_work: NYCEDC is seeking proposals ( Proposals each a Proposal ) from qualified parties ( Respondents 1, each a Respondent ) for the disposition and development of a mixed use residential building on land owned by NYCEDC and the City known as B-East. The Project is intended to advance the City s housing affordability and economic development goals by delivering new, high-quality, mixed-income housing and community-serving uses and contributing to a more vibrant and equitable East Harlem neighborhood. The Site is located in the Upper Manhattan neighborhood of East Harlem and is part of Manhattan Community District 11 and City Council District 8. It is situated between East 125th Street and East 126th Street, along 2nd Avenue in Manhattan, New York (Block 1790, Lots 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30 and 31, on the tax map of the Borough of Manhattan),
